A '''thermal flak jacket''' was a type of personal clothing. [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Rebel trooper/Legends|soldiers]] wore thermal flak jackets while serving on the [[Water/Legends|ice]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] as part of their [[Alliance Cold Weather armor|cold-weather outfit]].
